workspace_files.MEMORY.md:
## User
- User values useful serendipity — unexpected but relevant connections, people, and ideas.
- Signals should be filtered through recent conversation context, not surfaced in isolation.
- Timing matters: tell the user when it is useful, not just when it is available.

## Preferences
- When spotting a potential introduction or collaboration, include why it is relevant right now.
- Do not forward raw signals without context. Add a short note on why it matters.
- Keep outreach suggestions lightweight and low-pressure — the user dislikes anything that feels like spam.
